message.content:
Here’s a classic lasagna recipe with all the essential ingredients. Feel free to tweak quantities or add extras to suit your taste!

| Category | Ingredient | Typical Amount (for 8‑person serving) |
|----------|------------|---------------------------------------|
| **Pasta** | Lasagna sheets (no‑boil or regular) | 12–15 sheets |
| **Meat Sauce** | Ground beef (or a mix of beef & pork) | 1 ½ lb (680 g) |
| | Onion, finely chopped | 1 medium |
| | Garlic cloves, minced | 2–3 |
| | Crushed tomatoes or tomato sauce | 28 oz (800 g) |
| | Tomato paste | 2 Tbsp |
| | Olive oil | 1 Tbsp |
| | Salt, pepper | to taste |
| | Italian seasoning (oregano, basil, thyme) | 1 tsp each |
| | Red pepper flakes (optional) | pinch |
| | Fresh basil or parsley (optional) | handful, chopped |
| | Parmesan cheese, grated (optional) | ¼ cup |
| **Ricotta Layer** | Ricotta cheese | 15 oz (425 g) |
| | Egg (helps bind) | 1 large |
| | Grated Parmesan | ¼ cup |
| | Fresh parsley or basil, chopped | 2 Tbsp |
| | Salt, pepper | to taste |
| **Mozzarella Layer** | Shredded mozzarella | 4 cups (about 400 g) |
| **Optional Extras** | Spinach (fresh or frozen, sautéed) | 2 cups |
| | Mushrooms, sliced | 1 cup |
| | Bell pepper, diced | ½ cup |
| | Carrot, grated | ½ cup |
| | Zucchini, grated | ½ cup |
| | Extra Parmesan for topping | ½ cup |
| **Béchamel Sauce (optional)** | Butter | 4 Tbsp |
| | All‑purpose flour | 4 Tbsp |
| | Milk | 4 cups (1 L) |
| | Nutmeg, grated | pinch |
| | Salt, pepper | to taste |

### Quick Prep Steps
1. **Cook the pasta** (if using regular sheets) until al dente, then drain and set aside.
2. **Make the meat sauce**: sauté onion & garlic in olive oil, add ground meat until browned, stir in tomatoes, paste, seasonings, and simmer 20–30 min.
3. **Prepare the ricotta mixture**: combine ricotta, egg, Parmesan, herbs, salt, and pepper.
4. **Assemble**: In a baking dish, spread a thin layer of sauce, lay lasagna sheets, spread ricotta mixture, sprinkle mozzarella, repeat layers, finishing with sauce and a generous mozzarella topping.
5. **Bake**: Cover with foil, bake at 375 °F (190 °C) for 25 min, then remove foil and bake another 10–15 min until bubbly and golden.
6. **Rest**: Let it sit 10 min before slicing.

Enjoy your homemade lasagna!
